name: What are the common types of glass used for interior glass walls?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of glass used for interior glass walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior glass walls commonly use tempered or laminated glass for safety and durability. Tempered glass is heat-treated to be four to five times stronger than standard glass and shatters into small, blunt pieces if broken. Laminated glass consists of two or more glass panes bonded with a plastic interlayer, which holds the glass together if it breaks. The choice depends on the specific application, desired level of sound insulation, and safety requirements. For instance, a higher traffic area might benefit more from laminated glass due to its enhanced safety properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tempered and laminated glass are commonly used for interior glass walls due to their safety and durability. The best type depends on the specific application and safety needs.
